item.title: Ethel's Bakery, LLC: Ethel's Gluten Free Turtle Dandy Dessert Bars 6oz, Recall
item.product: Ethel's Gluten Free Turtle Dandy Dessert Bars 6oz,
item.summary: Product mix-up resulting in incorrect product identity, inaccurate ingredient declaration (extra ingredients declared that are not present in the product), and inaccurate Nutrition Facts. Product details: Ethel's Gluten Free Turtle Dandy Dessert Bars 6oz, UPC 8 50054 16601 2, 6 retail units per case
item.affectedPeople: Arizona, Colorado, Illinois, Indiana, Maryland, Michigan, New Hampshire, New York, Oregon, and Pennsylvania.
item.payoutAmount: Refund, replacement, correction, or disposal if stated by the official notice
